title: The Home of a Pokemon -- The Pokeball
author: AsterAlff

generated.description: A giant Pokéball-shaped house built as a home for a Pokémon, with a red and white sphere shell, a gray center band, and a black-and-gray button detail. It sits on a grassy dirt base with a small water pond around it, and it is about 66 blocks wide, 105 high, and 130 deep. Inside it has a chest, a furnace, and a sign, and it is decorated with glass, lapis, and glowstone accents.
